restrictions: Ordinary fixed-IV collision via the published Li-Liu-Wang-Dong-Sun ASIACRYPT 2024 practical 31-step route (two-block SFS-to-collision), not a generic birthday search.
Online algorithm is deterministic replay of two distinct 128-byte advice messages; success_probability=1 after organizer certificate verification of the selected-target digests.

All historical construction (characteristic search, SAT/SMT, precomputation, matching, failed trials, verification) is charged inside preprocessing_log2 and total time_log2; a stored pair is not treated as free.

Declared time_log2=50 is a conservative public-envelope bound under H-FULL-ATTACK-ENVELOPE (EUROCRYPT 2024 published 2^49.8 complete constructive complexity), not the knife-edge ASIACRYPT matching-phase headline 2^40.5.
No v5 word-op discount is taken against published figures; publication units are charged as target-compression equivalents under H-PUB-UNITS.
baseline_improved names the required nominal reference identifier and does not assert a cryptanalytic improvement over that nominal as a proved security statement.

heuristics.statement: Published SHA-256 collision-attack time figures cited here (EUROCRYPT 2024 time 2^49.8; ASIACRYPT 2024 slides time 2^40.5) are treated as upper bounds measured in selected-target compression-equivalent evaluations of sha256-r31, not as wall-clock seconds and not as discounted v5 word-RAM totals.
heuristics.scope: Conversion of the two cited publication time figures into collision-frontier-v5 target-compression units for this exact 31-round fixed-IV padded target.
heuristics.extrapolation: No discount of 1/C is applied even if some published work is non-compression RAM or SAT work; the declared envelope therefore overcharges relative to a literal word-op split.
heuristics.limitations: Authors do not publish an organizer-model ledger. If a cited figure secretly counted only a strict subset of charged work, or used a cheaper unit than one compression, the unit map could understate cost; the separate H-FULL-ATTACK-ENVELOPE margin is the primary defense against that failure mode.

heuristics.statement: Every historical operation that produced the retained colliding pair — including differential-characteristic search, SAT/SMT tool runs, starting-point generation, table precomputation, matching, failed trials, additional experiments beyond a lucky first hit, message finalization, and verification — totals at most 2^49.9 organizer target-compression equivalents, dominated by the Li-Liu-Wang EUROCRYPT 2024 published complete constructive complexity 2^49.8 for ordinary 31-step SHA-256 collisions.
heuristics.scope: All offline/historical work charged to preprocessing and total time for this fixed-witness package; excludes only the online six-compression replay.
heuristics.extrapolation: The ASIACRYPT 2024 memory-efficient matching phase (slides: time 2^40.5, about 2^19.8 table tuples, 1.2 h on 64 threads) is treated as an optimization of the matching stage inside that envelope, not as a license to declare total historical cost near 2^40.5 without a discovery ledger.
heuristics.limitations: No immutable job ledger, instruction trace, or organizer-unit conversion receipt for the authors' discovery work is available in the public sources used here. If characteristic search plus all omitted experiments truly exceeded 2^49.9 compression-equivalents, the time_log2=50 claim would fail while the certificate collision itself would remain valid. This package deliberately refuses knife-edge claims near 2^40.5–2^41 for that reason.

heuristics.statement: The two 128-byte certificate messages are the public ordinary 31-step SHA-256 colliding pair associated with Li, Liu, Wang, Dong, and Sun, ASIACRYPT 2024 (also distributed in the authors' verification materials), and they collide under sha256-r31-prefix-v1.
heuristics.scope: Identity and selected-target correctness of the retained advice pair only.
heuristics.extrapolation: Correctness of the online algorithm does not depend on this bibliographic identity: the organizer certificate checker recomputes both digests. The identity statement only ties the historical-cost heuristics to the public attack that produced the pair.
heuristics.limitations: Bibliographic attribution does not measure resource cost. Cost obligations remain entirely with H-PUB-UNITS and H-FULL-ATTACK-ENVELOPE.
